answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The violet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the forge is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
